origin.description: Estimates how far the variances should shrink toward their median.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A data matrix, one observation per row.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. Omitted means equal weights that sum to 1.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.text: Print the intensity. The default is true.

origin.details: Fewer than three rows raises an error. A zero denominator returns 1. The result is clamped to 0 and 1.
